en: A vintage sepia-toned panoramic view of a busy waterfront city. Multi‑story European buildings line a quayside crowded with pedestrians, trams, and horse‑drawn vehicles. Numerous steamships and smaller boats are moored along piers and moving through a wide waterway that is crossed by low bridges further in the distance. On the right, a tree‑covered hill rises with a small domed chapel-like building, while the far background shows a dense cityscape with several towers and domes under a cloudy sky. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the front.
